_comment: LCDM-objective exploration — the consolidated replacement for the retired root parameter_sweep.py (OBJECTIVE='lcdm'). Scores each cell by R^2-style match vs the analytic LCDM baseline (compute_match_metrics -> match_avg_pct / diff_pct) instead of chi2 vs the real Pantheon+ SNe. The cache slug includes 'lcdmobj' so these runs never collide with pantheon-objective caches. Timing mirrors the old script's non-leet window (t_start=5.8). Best config is chosen by MAX match_avg_pct; chi2_dof is not produced in this mode (compute_match_metrics emits no chi2), so the standard sweep CSV is emitted with chi2_dof left infinite for lcdm rows.
